title: PersonaContextStatus
description: Cache-derived state of a persona's compiled AI context document, as listed by `GET /v1/personas/aiContext/status`. Read from the context cache without compiling — see ADR:2026-10-14-persona-ai-context-status-reads-the-cache-and-pages-like-the-persona-list.

personaId.description: Id of the persona this status belongs to.

cacheState.description: State of the cached document. A persona with nothing cached reports `STALE`.

lastGeneratedAt.description: When the cached document was compiled. Absent when nothing is cached.

entitiesIncluded.description: Entities rendered into the cached document. Zero when nothing is cached.

tokensEst.description: Estimated tokens in the cached document, `ceil(characters / 4)` as on the document endpoint. Zero when nothing is cached.

lastError.description: Reason the latest compilation failed, when it did.
